主動 Call／Raise 手數 ÷ 可作自願翻前決策手數；不含 walk、強制: Hands with a voluntary preflop call or raise divided by hands with a voluntary preflop decision. Excludes walks, forced blinds and antes.

盲位直接面對 first-in open、尚無 caller 時 Fold 次數: Folds from the blinds directly facing a first-in open with no caller, divided by matching opportunities.
盲位直接面對 first-in open、尚無 caller 時 Call 次數: Calls from the blinds directly facing a first-in open with no caller, divided by matching opportunities.
盲位直接面對 first-in open、尚無 caller 時 Raise 次: Raises from the blinds directly facing a first-in open with no caller, divided by matching opportunities.
最後翻前 aggressor 在 flop 無人先下注時 Bet 次數 ÷ 同類: Flop bets by the final preflop aggressor when no player has bet first, divided by matching betting opportunities.
Hero 直接面對 flop C-bet 而 Fold 次數 ÷ 同類可決策機會: Folds directly facing a flop continuation bet divided by matching decision opportunities. Excludes intervening raises.
Hero 到 showdown 手數 ÷ Hero saw flop 手數。: Hands in which Hero reaches showdown divided by hands in which Hero saw the flop.
Hero showdown 收到 contested pot 派彩手數 ÷ He: Showdown hands in which Hero receives a contested-pot payout divided by Hero showdown hands. Split pots count as wins.
Hero saw flop 並收到 contested pot 派彩手數 ÷ H: Hands in which Hero saw the flop and receives a contested-pot payout divided by hands in which Hero saw the flop.

study.subtitle: Explore decisions, compare strategy, and build a daily review routine.
study.pathHelp: Enter every action in order from the first selected street, excluding the current Hero decision. Postflop analysis covers hands heads-up from the flop.
study.secondBarrel: Facing the second barrel after a c-bet
study.denominatorHelp: Frequency uses decision opportunities; one hand may contain several. Net counts each hand once and is not the EV of an action.
study.noDecisions: No matching decisions. Broaden the filters or import hand histories.
study.leakHelp: Compare matched preflop strategy and your own postflop target intervals. Without a target, results remain observations.
study.noLeaks: No comparisons yet. Add a target, or import strategy and collect matching hands.
study.leakCaveat: Ranking is a descriptive review cue, not significance, profit prediction, or EV loss. GTO targets use the observed hand mix; the default minimum is 100 opportunities.
study.strategyTitle: Compare decisions in their strategy context
study.strategyHelp: Import a Nexus manifest to compare a 169-cell strategy with observed frequencies. Only matching configurations enter deviation statistics.
study.packImported: Imported {{files}} files and {{nodes}} nodes; {{issues}} cells need source verification.
study.noPack: Import an NL10 6-max 100bb Nexus pack to begin.
study.matrixHelp: Strategy frequencies are conditional on reaching the node. ? marks inconsistent source weights excluded from grading. Observed frequencies include matched decisions only.
study.modelCaveat: The current adapter cannot verify complete model and rake settings from hand histories. Historical comparisons remain reference-only and are excluded from GTO deviations and grading. Internally consistent cells and ancestry support selected-model theory drills. No decision EV is supplied; no EV loss is calculated.
study.reason.unreachable_hand: Hand does not reach this node
study.trainerHelp: Add cards from your hands or the strategy matrix. Decide and explain your reasoning before revealing the strategy and original action.
study.noDue: No cards due. Add decisions from spots or the strategy matrix.
study.staleQuestion: The original hand no longer exists. Skip this card.
study.inStrategy: This action has positive source frequency; it is not necessarily the action to choose every time.
study.outOfStrategy: This action has zero frequency in the source strategy.
study.rateHelp: Rate your understanding. Advance schedules reviews after 1, 3, 7, 14, then 30 days. Repeat schedules tomorrow.
study.trainerCaveat: Postflop cards use self-review without GTO grading. Practice is for offline study.
study.preflopPath: Full preflop path (F / C / X / R size)
study.matchedCohort: Same pre-decision cohort as GTO statistics
study.referenceCohort: Manual reference cohort; excluded from GTO deviations and grading
